test_detect_hardline_command: test that detect_hardline_command correctly blocks catastrophic commands like rm -rf slash and reboot
test_check_dangerous_command: test that check_dangerous_command returns hardline blocked for destructive commands in local environment
test_check_all_command_guards: test that check_all_command_guards blocks hardline commands even when yolo mode is enabled
test_yolo_cannot_bypass_hardline: test that enabling yolo mode via env var or session cannot bypass the hardline blocklist
test_container_backends_bypass: test that containerized backends like docker and singularity are allowed to bypass hardline checks
